extension.summary: Live TV, TV guide, catch-up, movies and series from your Xtream Codes provider
extension.description: Watch your Xtream Codes IPTV subscription in Kodi, without the PVR IPTV Simple client.[CR][CR][B]Live TV[/B]: TV mode with channel list, mini player and programme schedule; fast Up/Down and CH+/CH- zapping with a channel banner; number entry and channel recall (0); favourites; a full grid TV guide; offline channels detected and skipped.[CR][B]Catch-up[/B]: watch earlier programmes, or restart the current one from its beginning with the Rewind key.[CR][B]Movies and series[/B]: browse by category, recently added, resume and Continue watching, optional export to the Kodi library.[CR][B]Discover[/B]: trending, popular and top-rated titles with TMDb ratings, showing only what your provider has.[CR][B]Also[/B]: search (including the TV guide), reminders, sleep timer, Trakt scrobbling, hide or rename groups, adult filter with PIN, backup and restore, configurable User-Agent, background channel and EPG updates, and an option to start straight into TV mode.[CR][CR]You need a subscription from an Xtream Codes provider. This add-on does not provide any content.
extension.news: 1.14.3: Leaving the add-on now stops the channel from everywhere, not just TV mode: Back out of the grid guide, or out of a list (Live TV, catch-up, search, a reminder pop-up) while a channel plays. Kodi keeps a stream started from a list playing in the background, so only sound was left; the setting is now called "Stop playback when leaving the add-on" (Settings > TV mode). A guide opened over the picture still returns to it, and a movie or episode from your Kodi library is never touched. 1.14.2: Zapping timing fix: the online check is quick (a HEAD request, no stream opened) and a channel that just played is not checked again for 10 minutes, so switching channels no longer runs through the list checking every channel - and a check that was refused while another stream was open no longer leaves a good channel marked offline. 1.14.1: Zapping. CH+/CH- and PageUp/PageDown now work in TV mode too, and the mini player can follow the highlighted channel after a short pause (Settings > TV mode > Preview the highlighted channel, off by default). With "Keep the checked channel playing" (Settings > Playback, on) the next channel is checked while the current one is still playing, so a channel change starts sooner. 1.14.0: Skins. Settings > Display > Skin picks the look of TV mode, the TV guide and the channel banner: the usual dark blue, or STBEmu / Stalker portal (black, grey text, orange highlights, narrower channel column, smaller video window). 1.13.6: TV guide search results are easier to read: Today/Tomorrow/Yesterday instead of a bare time, how soon an upcoming programme starts (in 25 min), (recording) on catch-up results, and the channel number.
